articles.title: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The U.S. Supreme Court hasn't yet indicated whether it will take up cases surrounding prediction markets, but there are now several amicus briefs, an interim final rule and a rule proposal.

articles.title: Clarity's failure could speed crypto innovation while shielding incumbents
articles.snippet: Executives see openings for tokenization, DeFi and dealmaking, while lawyers warn agency action leaves spot-market oversight and lasting certainty unresolved.

articles.title: President Trump declares 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine
articles.snippet: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well," said Ukrainian President Zelensky.

articles.title: IMF finds demand for tokenized stocks, says the market is still volatile, illiquid
articles.snippet: Investors are using blockchain-based shares for smaller and after-hours trades. The IMF says liquidity, legal rules and settlement systems have not caught up.

articles.title: One year after 10/10 flash crash, bitcoin and ether liquidity have rebuilt, but altcoins still face risks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and ether order books are deeper than before the crash, while altcoin liquidity keeps eroding and spot trading remains well below its October 2025 peak.
